what_it_is.prose: Lockheed Martin states that the Indian Air Force operates 12 C-130J aircraft and that Tata Lockheed Martin Aerostructures Limited in Hyderabad is the global sole source for C-130J empennage assemblies included on new Super Hercules aircraft. This gives India a significant role in the international manufacturing supply chain for the platform while the aircraft itself remains U.S.-origin. The dossier therefore separates Indian aerostructure production from overall platform sovereignty and does not infer an indigenous percentage.
